name: A Quiet Chart
effect: The Loom is unwritten and the chart stays honest.
context: The Loom is unwritten and its work stays done.
epilogue: The Loom is gone, the erasures keep their silence, and the chart agrees with itself and nothing else. Nobody raises the volume again, which is what winning looks like out here.

name: The Core Ends
effect: The ship becomes the argument the crew could not make.
context: The hull goes into the core at full burn.
epilogue: The ship stops being a ship and the frame keeps the shape it left. The record that survives is the only salvage that matters, and nobody who reads it will know what was refused.
